DESCRIPTION: This screenshot displays the ElevenLabs admin dashboard with a dark-themed sidebar and a main configuration area for an AI agent named "Support agent." The interface features a system prompt editor, voice selection (ElevenLabs voices like Jessica), language settings (Arabic, English & Tamil), LLM configuration (GPT-5 Nano), and a first message field with Arabic text. The left sidebar includes navigation for Overview, Configure (Agent, Procedures, Workflow, Knowledge Base), and Monitor sections.

APP: **ElevenLabs admin dashboard**

SCREEN: **Agent Configuration / Agent Builder**
